company.shortDescription: Mindbody is a wellness experience platform that allows clients to find and engage with fitness, beauty, and integrative health services.
company.description:
Mindbody is a wellness experience platform that connects users to fitness, beauty, and integrative health services. Fitness studios, salons, spas, and integrative health centers—use Mindbody's integrated software and payments platform to run, market, and grow their businesses. Consumers use Mindbody to find, engage, and transact with wellness providers in their local communities and around the world.

Mindbody helps people lead healthier, happier lives by connecting the world to wellness. It was founded in 2001 and headquartered in San Luis Obispo, California.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Private Equity round raised $500,000,000, or 81.37% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $450,000,000 to $450,000,000, a 1x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 47 (+3 over 90 days) and market heat at 40 (-8).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
